## What this changes and why

## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` or the crate README updated if behaviour or conventions changed
- [ ] No tokens, message text or personal data in the change, its tests or its description
